ios.desc: Popular Pays is an Agile Advertising Platform where Brands & talented Creators connect to collaborate & create content. Brands are looking to creators for content or influence - and sometimes for both. They need content to support their own Agile Advertising efforts and want to tap into the authentic and close connection that influencers have with their followers to raise awareness for their brands. The Popular Pays Agile Advertising Suite supports Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and Pinterest. Use our app to browse, apply, create (and get paid for) your work. Brands of all sizes work with us – from Hyatt to Mother Raw (update this brand?) – and they’re looking for beautiful, engaging, and innovative content from Creators on social media. Download the app, sign up, and Create Something Worth Sharing.

quotes.text:
Popular Pays - Chicago, IL

We're democratizing social currency. Imagine a Klout for local business, where you can get a cup of coffee if you have a bunch of Instagram followers. But instead of caring about whether or not Justin Bieber retweeted you, we measure influence based on your ability to get your followers to visit that shop you just posted about. Oh yeah, it's possible.

We're a recently-launched and VC-funded startup and you've got to be a full-stack / back-end engineer as good as our mobile dev: @mxcl, the guy who made Homebrew. (Yeah, that thing you use everyday.)

Here's our app: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/popular-pays/id673760702?mt=8

Here's some press: http://www.fastcoexist.com/3015760/change-generation/your-instagram-followers-are-good-for-more-than-just-likes-now-they-get-yo

* Since none of the 4 current teammates are taking a salary, there's plenty of Seed Funding left for you. Equity, too.

* We've got our own unique space inside of an ad agency downtown that they gave to us, but you can work where ever you want.

* We'll pay for gym, laundry, and anything that's a distraction from doing shit you don't want to do.

* Vision/Health/Dental/Medical covered 100%.

* We don't count vacation days.

* We pay your phone bill and when you join we'll upgrade you to the newest iPhone. We might have to steal from somebody if you want a gold one though.

* You'll get a dope computer…duh.
